title: KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry
abstract: arXiv:2610.37655v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Atmospheric chemical mechanisms are commonly distributed in the language of the Kinetic PreProcessor (KPP), which generates efficient Fortran or C code but does not fit into the differentiable programming frameworks in which machine-learning models are developed. We present KPPax, a kinetic preprocessor that generates differentiable, just-in-time compiled, and vectorisable chemistry code in JAX from mechanisms written in the KPP language. KPPax evaluates the rate law with sparse operations in log space, which keeps it differentiable, and integrates the stiff system with the implicit solvers and the forward- and reverse-mode adjoints of the \texttt{diffrax} library, so that exact sensitivities are obtained without hand-derived adjoint code. We demonstrate two applications with the POLLU benchmark mechanism. translated_title: KPPax：为大气化学中的机器学习预处理可微分动力学常微分方程
translated_abstract: 大气化学机理通常以动力学预处理器语言的形式发布，该预处理器可生成高效的 Fortran 或 C 代码，但无法融入开发机器学习模型所使用的可微分编程框架。我们提出了 KPPax，这是一个动力学预处理器，能够将以 KPP 语言编写的机理转化为 JAX 中可微分、即时编译且可向量化的化学代码。KPPax 在对数空间中通过稀疏运算计算速率定律，从而保持其可微分性，并利用 diffrax 库的隐式求解器以及前向和反向模式伴随方法对刚性系统进行积分，因此无需手工推导伴随代码即可获得精确的敏感度。我们使用 POLLU 基准机理演示了两个应用。在第一个应用中，由自动微分雅可比矩阵计算得到的 Fisher 信息矩阵可以在任何参数拟合之前预测哪些……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: KPPax 是一个动力学预处理器，能将 KPP 语言描述的大气化学机理转化为 JAX 中可微分、即时编译且可向量化的代码，并结合稀疏对数空间运算与 diffrax 隐式求解器，无需手工推导伴随代码即可获得精确敏感度。
en_tdlr: KPPax is a kinetic preprocessor that translates KPP-language atmospheric chemistry mechanisms into differentiable, JIT-compiled, and vectorisable JAX code, using sparse log-space rate-law evaluation and diffrax's implicit solvers to obtain exact sensitivities without hand-derived adjoint code.
